ReleaseNotes:
v1.5.0 - LogRhythm 7.23 GA API Coverage

Phase 1 - Compliance Audit:
- Fixed 8 logic bugs, 3 critical violations, 27 high priority, 18 medium/low issues across 50+ existing cmdlets
- Renamed Run-LrTrueIdentityMerger to Invoke-LrTrueIdentityMerger
- Standardized Invoke-RestAPIMethod -Origin $Me across all cmdlets
- Added Enable-TrustAllCertsPolicy to all Begin blocks
- Added -PassThru to all mutating cmdlets

Phase 2 - New Cmdlets (~120 new):
- Admin/MPERules: 10 cmdlets (policy/rule CRUD, summary, status, policy-rule management)
- Admin/LogSources/LSV: 10 cmdlets (LSV template CRUD, template items, log source virtualization)
- Admin/Beats: 8 cmdlets (beat CRUD, types, templates, status, heartbeat)
- Admin/OpenCollectors: 7 cmdlets (OC CRUD, status, heartbeat, beats listing)
- Admin/LogSources: 9 cmdlets (pending log source actions, matching, status)
- Admin/Users: 16 cmdlets (persons, user logins, user profiles, privileges, permissions)
- Admin/Agents: 3 cmdlets (agent create, update, partial update)
- Admin/Hosts: 3 cmdlets (batch update, host roles)
- Admin/Entities: 3 cmdlets (entity/host/network import)
- Admin/Networks: 1 cmdlet (batch update)
- Admin/NotificationGroups: 5 cmdlets (group CRUD, user management)
- Admin/MsgSourceTypes: 5 cmdlets (message source type CRUD)
- Admin/Licenses: 2 cmdlets (license info, entitlements)
- Admin/Identities: 4 cmdlets (bulk add, photo, merged, list lookup)
- Admin/Location: 1 cmdlet (location details)
- Alarms: 1 cmdlet (alarm URL, 7.7.0+)
- Case/Evidence: 12 cmdlets (file/event evidence, progress, download, logs index, file upload)
- Case/Playbooks: 2 cmdlets (export, partial update)
- Case/Attachments: 8 cmdlets (playbook/case-playbook attachment CRUD and download)
- Case/History: 1 cmdlet (global history)
- Case/General: 4 cmdlets (logs indexes, capabilities, feature flags, log maintenance)
- Case/Metrics: 1 cmdlet (case metrics update)
- AIE/Engine: 3 cmdlets (rule import, status update, service restart)
- Metrics: 2 cmdlets (log volume, TTL details)

Phase 6 - Module Configuration Cmdlets:
- Initialize-LrtConfiguration: guided first-time setup (replaces separate Setup.ps1 workflow)
- Get-LrtConfiguration: display current config with secrets masked
- Set-LrtConfiguration: modify and persist config values per service
- Test-LrtConfiguration: validate config and test API connectivity
- Module now loads gracefully without pre-existing config
